claim: Hierarchical architectures outperform single-agent baselines because the context they propagate provides an information advantage that guides search toward the correct region in fewer iterations.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by measuring the information content of propagated context and correlating it with search efficiency in controlled experiments.

conditions: CO adsorption on Cu-surface adatoms and M–N–C catalysts
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific hierarchical architectures studied and the two chemical domains; the causal mechanism is inferred from observed performance differences.

title: Context propagation in hierarchical–Search efficiency mechanism
